events.title: Devlog: Making Every Shot Count — Anatomy, Fair Aim and a Rebalanced Hunt
events.summary: Hi hunters! This update was shaped by your feedback, so here is the story behind it.Every shot is judged by what it hitsA real hunter knows exactly where a good shot lands. Each animal now has organs placed inside its body: heart, lungs, liver, spine and more. Your score, your objectives and the new x-ray shot replay all follow what your bullet actually hit.Fair aim, real skillThe aim assist used to pull straight to the heart, which made perfect shots too easy. events.title: Devlog: Hunters Trial Triples in Size - 120 Levels & New Modes
events.summary: Hi hunters! Steam Next Fest gave us more feedback than we ever expected, and it pushed us to do something big before launch: the full game is now three times larger. Here is what changed.120 levels in 12 actsThe campaign grows from 40 to 120 levels.
